name: POST /api/leadflow/segments - a versioned, purpose-bound definition
description:
Saves a segment definition as a new VERSION (73357dd8-628f-47fa-9e41-1b42cf1f23fc#AC4). A definition is immutable once written and an edit supersedes rather than updates, because an audience computed last week must stay explainable against the definition that produced it - an in-place update silently rewrites the reason every past snapshot exists.

THE PURPOSE AND CHANNEL ARE PART OF THE DEFINITION, not of the send. A segment built for project operations and later reused for marketing SMS is how a licensed record ends up in an audience its source rights forbid; making the purpose a property of the segment turns that reuse into a NEW segment, which gets its own eligibility pass.

A partial unique index keeps exactly one current version per key, so "which definition is live" has one answer. QA: measured live.

testCases.name: A definition is stored as version 1 with its purpose and channel
NEGATIVE: a channel outside the known list
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: segment_key, name, purpose_key and channel are all required
errorCases.when: any required field is missing, or the channel is outside email, sms, voice, in_app, any.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
